products.name: UiPath AI
products.note: RPA + AI platform; document understanding; process mining; enterprise automation governance

profile_text.body:
UiPath is a New York-based, publicly traded enterprise software company (NYSE: PATH) founded in 2005. Its website describes the UiPath Platform as a system for business orchestration and automation that brings together AI agents, robotic process automation, and human workers on a single platform, with the stated aim of helping enterprises scale automated work while maintaining governance and producing measurable outcomes. The company describes its offering as purpose-built for critical business workflows, covering areas such as document understanding, process mining, software testing automation, and agentic AI, without requiring the replacement of existing systems.

The site's tracked AI product, UiPath AI, encompasses the company's RPA and AI platform, including document understanding, process mining, and enterprise automation governance capabilities. UiPath files with the SEC under CIK 0001734722, and the held facts record 220 legal matters associated with the New York jurisdiction, though no specific case details are included in the available data.
